verdict.rationale: Keycloak is an IAM/OIDC server, so asynchronous human approval such as CIBA is a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence pack never documents CIBA or any transaction-approval flow. The documented device authorization grant is a related but different capability: it covers login on limited-input devices, not per-transaction human confirmation for an agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require asynchronous human approval (e.g. CIBA-style confirmation) before an autonomous agent completes a sensitive transaction
